summary: Refined system architecture by integrating formal methods for reliability and optimizing memory management through LRU eviction and hybrid semantic-keyword cache retrieval. These updates standardize error handling, ensure lean operational footprints, and improve long-term memory retrieval precision.
key_learnings: Layering probabilistic filters and ADTs ensures reliable, schema-compliant output and reduces silent failures.
LRU policies and hybrid search (Vector + Keyword) significantly improve cache longevity and retrieval precision for technical identifiers.
Architectural decisions are prioritized by their leverage for autonomous cycles, focusing on self-repair and memory management over premature optimization.
